name: od-visual-regression
description: OD Visual Regression の WordPress・Runner モノレポ

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-visual-regression wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-visual-regression.pot --domain=od-visual-regression
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-visual-regression wp i18n make-mo languages
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@odvr/shared && npm run build --workspace=@odvr/runner
